taskTemplate.name: Send Disclosures Closed End
taskTemplate.description: Send required loan disclosures to borrower for closed-end loans

subTaskTemplate.name: Program Selection
subTaskTemplate.description: Program Selection – Verify the program is marked appropriately for this loan.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Program Selection

subTaskTemplate.name: Index
subTaskTemplate.description: Index – Index pulled as of today when the loan program is an ARM. Use "Get Index" button.

subTaskTemplate.name: Plan Code
subTaskTemplate.description: Plan Code - Set Applicable Plan Code
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Plan Code

subTaskTemplate.name: Fee Review
subTaskTemplate.description: Fee Review – Review Itemization and ensure fees are accurate.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Fee Review

subTaskTemplate.name: 1003 – Demographic
subTaskTemplate.description: 1003 – Demographic – Demographic information is always collected on closed-end loans. Ensure method collected, Race, Ethnicity and Sex are documented.

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – All Scores
subTaskTemplate.description: FACT Act Disclosure – All Scores – All scores for all borrowers from all credit bureaus pulled on the credit report are evidenced on the FACT Act Disclosure. (Be sure to check second borrower pair as well).
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – FACT Act Disclosure – All Scores

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – Checkboxes
subTaskTemplate.description: FACT Act Disclosure – Checkboxes – Ensure the 'Material Terms of Credit set by Credit Score' and 'Credit Score for Disclosure Notice' check boxes on the Disclosure Notice are checked when a credit score is available and unchecked when a score is not available.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – FACT Act Disclosure – Checkboxes

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – Key Factors
subTaskTemplate.description: FACT Act Disclosure – Key Factors – Verify that the Key Factors informational text is present for every credit score to be disclosed for all borrowers and all bureaus pulled.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – FACT Act Disclosure – Key Factors

subTaskTemplate.name: Home Counseling List
subTaskTemplate.description: Home Counseling List – Import Home Counseling List. Click Save before completing task.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Home Counseling List

subTaskTemplate.name: Flood Cert
subTaskTemplate.description: Flood Cert – This subtask is completed automatically upon completion of the separate Order Flood Certificate task — do not complete manually.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Flood Cert

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – eConsent
subTaskTemplate.description: eConsent – Verify eConsent is received before sending electronically.

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – Contact Info
subTaskTemplate.description: Contact Info – Verify email and phone are present before sending electronically.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – FACT Act Disclosure – Contact Info

subTaskTemplate.name: Loan Audit
subTaskTemplate.description: Loan Audit – Open eFolder and run Loan Audit. Address findings if applicable.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Loan Audit

subTaskTemplate.name: FACT Act Disclosure – Ready to Send
subTaskTemplate.description: Ready to Send – Ready to Send Disclosure. Mark Done to send electronically. Mark Issue to send via mail (must complete manually).
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Disclosures Closed End – Ready to Send
